note: Display-only rule used by the site to decide which players to list. Nothing is stored: the site evaluates it at display time on the selected window's gp, min and pir. A player is eligible in a window when ALL of that window's thresholds are met. l3 and l5 follow the old Fantasy filter (GP3 >= 1, MIN3 >= 10, GP5 >= 3, PIR >= 5); season and l10 are placeholders to confirm.
